message: 心配事は絶えない

message: 「Just what was that all about...?」

message: 「They felt tougher than the Demons we've fought so far.」

message: 「Yeah.」

message: 「Heh heh heh... Those moves--they ain't your average Demons.」

message: 「Sharp as ever, Ria-chan. You're quick on the uptake.」

message: 「But why would anyone target us?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, isn't it because we're in their way?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if they're trying to take advantage of Re-Crea to pull off something nasty.」

message: 「I'd say the odds of that are pretty high.」

message: 「I don't really get all this complicated stuff~!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Either way, the Crusaders will punish all the bad kids!」

name: Ria
message: 「Good and proper~\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Defeat is simply not an option for the Crusaders」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, we just gotta keep doing our best like always!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Having everyone here is super reassuring」
If it's something like this, Macaron might be willing to help out too.

name: Sally
message: 「Well then, I've got my part-time shift at the beef bowl place, so~」

message: 「Good luck~」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's finish up the rest of our work too, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, let's do our best」

message: 「Meow...」

name: Pasta
